span.p:
2003 ─ Google SRE founded,
SLO concept developed internally

2010 ─ Etsy deploy SLO introduced during
continuous deployment rollout

2005 ─ Google error budget policy
implemented for Borg services

span.p:
2012 ─ LinkedIn feed SLO system launched
with member-tier SLOs

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2008 ─ Netflix starts SLO tracking
for streaming service

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
2014 ─ Uber dispatch SLO introduced for rider matching
Cloudflare per-datacenter SLO system goes live

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
2016 ─ Google SRE book published, SLO concepts

Discord messaging SLO system launched

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

2018 ─ Stripe payment SLO system with
processor dependency tracking
Spotify cache SLO introduced as leading indicator

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

2020 ─ GitHub SLO burn rate dashboard
open-sourced

2022 ─ Multi-window multi-burn-rate alerting

Cloud providers launch native SLO products
